name: lookma
description: Talk to your Mac. Watch it work. A voice-driven agent that operates your real screen in plain sight.
author: Jiawei Liu

scripts.check: for f in core/*.mjs core/executor/*.mjs core/voice/*.mjs core/dev/*.mjs executors/*/*.mjs executors/*/dev/*.mjs voices/*/*.mjs voices/*/*.js voices/*/dev/*.mjs overlay/*.js overlay/voice/*.js overlay/dev/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node core/dev/check-plugins.mjs && node core/dev/check-pipeline.mjs && node core/dev/check-outbox.mjs && node core/dev/check-executors.mjs && node core/dev/check-claude.mjs && for f in executors/*/dev/check.mjs voices/*/dev/check.mjs; do node $f || exit 1; done && node overlay/dev/consent-check.mjs && node overlay/dev/floor-check.mjs
